def: The mechanism by which a model replies with a structured request to run a named function with arguments, which your program runs before returning the result.
A standard vocabulary for describing the shape of a JSON document, used to define the arguments of a tool.
Generating output under a grammar compiled from a schema, so that every token emitted keeps the result valid.
A provider option that guarantees tool arguments conform to the declared schema, typically requiring closed objects and all fields listed as required.
Several tool requests emitted in one model turn, which the harness may run together and must answer with one result each.
A request setting that lets the model decide on tools (auto), requires some tool, requires a named tool, or forbids tools for a turn.
A thin layer that converts one internal message and tool format to and from each model API's wire format, keeping the agent loop independent of the provider.
Checking a model's tool arguments against the schema in your own code before running the tool, whatever the provider guarantees.
The identifier that ties a function result back to the model's call in OpenAI's Responses API, equivalent to tool_use_id in Anthropic's.
